headline: Up Your Arsenal now counts all levels, putting PAL progress at 8.38%
summary: Up Your Arsenal's PAL v1.00 matched-code figure changes from 49.25% to 8.38% because the report now counts the whole game, including all 49 level programs, and removes duplicate front-end code. It reports 5,193 of 16,164 entries finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. More C lands in both core and level programs as NTSC-U support is added.
highlights: The former percentage measured only core programs, so it is not directly comparable with the new whole-game figure.
The final NTSC-U progress commit reports 8.29% code and 5,140 of 16,222 finished entries.
All 54 NTSC-U programs rebuild byte-identically, although some functions still use original assembly.
PAL level batches carry over 1,334 shared functions, 74 level-specific functions and another 681 from US sources.
Two rewritten-history ranges cannot be compared on GitHub, leaving some activity unavailable.
